as_told.title: Christopher Dunn's work on the pyramid's engineering anomalies

plain: The claim is that the granite at the Giza pyramids in Egypt was cut with tools far more advanced than anything archaeologists have found. Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear site, relays the work of Christopher Dunn, an engineer, and also names the geologist Robert Schoch, saying the tools used to carve the granite "are not in the archaeological array of tools of copper and wooden chisels". Michels mentions Dunn on another episode more generally, as someone who has "done all this work on just engineering anomalies" of the pyramid itself. If true, the pyramids' builders would have had technology the record does not explain.
